legal.draft: Draft text for the university demo – not legal advice. Have it reviewed by a lawyer before taking real customers.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: OnlyWheels is a university demo shop (MSA project). No real orders are delivered and no real payments are taken.

sections.title: Orders and prices
sections.text: Prices are in RON and include 21% VAT. An order is confirmed once the payment is received; stock is reserved for 30 minutes while you pay.

sections.title: Delivery and fitting
sections.text: Courier delivery is free over 1,000 RON, otherwise 25 RON. With partner fitting, the products are delivered to the garage and you choose the date and time at checkout.

sections.title: Returns
sections.text: Consumers may withdraw within 14 days of receiving the products (GEO 34/2014), except for products that have been mounted or used.

sections.title: Complaints
sections.text: Write to contact@onlywheels.ro. You can also contact ANPC or use alternative dispute resolution (SAL).

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: Account details (name, email, phone), addresses, saved cars, favorites, reviews and orders.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: To process orders and fitting appointments, send order emails and keep your account. Legal basis: the contract and our legal obligations (accounting).

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: Account data until you delete your account; orders and invoices for the period required by accounting law.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: Access, rectification, erasure, portability and objection. In My account → Your data you can download your data or delete your account. You can complain to ANSPDCP.

sections.title: Processors
sections.text: Payment processor (Stripe), email provider and hosting. Data is stored in the EU.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.text: Login session (ow_access, ow_refresh) and security (csrftoken). They are required for the shop to work and need no consent.

sections.title: Local storage
sections.text: Your language, guest cart and selected car are kept in your browser.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: This demo uses no analytics or advertising cookies. If they are added later, they will only run after your consent.
